observed.caption: A tall modern glass skyscraper with gold lattice crowns rises behind a beige clock tower under a clear blue sky.
observed.description: A tall modern skyscraper with a blue glass facade and gold-colored lattice structures at the top dominates the center of the image against a pale blue sky with scattered small white clouds. In the foreground to the right, a beige clock tower with a large circular white and red clock face stands in front of the skyscraper, while a lower white and beige building with a grid of windows and three small flags on its roof is visible on the lower left. Two white streetlight poles with curved arms stand near the bottom center and bottom right, green treetops line the bottom edge, and additional low-rise buildings with flat roofs and beige and reddish walls are visible behind the clock tower on the right.
